name: get_session_snapshot
description:
Retrieves detailed information about a specific snapshot, including its creation time, size, expiration date, and the source session it was created from.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/snapshots/{snapshotId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

snapshotId.description: The unique identifier of the snapshot to retrieve.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
